userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: Secure user account and preference profile data.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: The user's verified or primary email address.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

bio.description: Short user bio or AI personalization preference.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

isBolexPlus.description: Whether the user holds an active Bolex Plus subscription tier.

isBolexUltra.description: Whether the user holds an active Bolex Ultra subscription tier.

isBolexQuantum.description: Whether the user holds an active Bolex Quantum subscription tier.

planTier.description: The current subscription tier (free, plus, ultra, or quantum).

trialStartedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the 3-day trial was started.

trialExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the 3-day trial expires.

publicProfile.title: Public Profile
publicProfile.description: Public directory profile for searching real human accounts in Bolex without exposing private PII.

uid.description: The user's unique Auth UID matching the document ID.

photoURL.description: URL to the account's avatar image.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user account joined Bolex.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private user account information. Only readable and writable by the user whose UID matches the document ID.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores publicly searchable user accounts in Bolex. No bots or fake accounts. Readable by signed-in users, writable only by the authenticated account owner.
